rows.notes: test_structure_cluster_portal_unclassified_0x4_*: verbatim sphere_intersects_cluster_portal (structures.c:344) with centroid/bounding_radius/plane_index varied (oracle: gate |P-C|^2<(R+r)^2, plane range); retail PVS host: out-of-range plane -> portal discarded before the hull builder (HULL reached=0). flags/unused: zero CE accesses (grep) and no result change.

sky_index: verbatim structure_visibility_find_camera (structure_visibility.c:363) sets visible_sky_index and calls scenario_get_sky with it. fog_reference: verbatim scenario_get_fog_region_index (scenario.c:632) incl. bit-15 plane form; region out of domain -> NONE.

plane (bytes 0-16): mutated plane d is the plane CE hands to portal_hull_from_points for the mirror (HANDOFFPLANE 100000, retail bloodgulch host). unused[5] (16-36): retained, handoff sequence and bytes_same unchanged. Note: the host hull stub always discards, so mirror_found is structurally 0; the observable is the plane handed to the hull builder.

world_bounds (24 bytes): verbatim render_frustum_cube_visible (render_cameras.c:521) returns 0 when the subcluster box is outside frustum world bounds, 2 when inside (planes set inside). Synthetic probe; the consumer call in structure_visibility_traverse_subclusters is the same expression.

resource_index: verbatim predicted_resources_precache + predicted_resource_valid (cache/predicted_resources.c) on tests/c4_parity_ranges_b_predicted_main.c modes 4-5 (index 0 -> BITMAP id=100; index 2 invalid -> dropped). Other entries unchanged.

vertex_indices (3 words): verbatim structure_render_dynamic_triangles_from_indices (structure_render.c:398) emits the triangle of that surface only; mutated vertex appears, unselected surface's mutation does not.

bsp3d_node_index: verbatim structure_render_surface_from_point_and_leaf (structures.c:517); NONE or a node whose plane_designator != plane_index yields found=0, matching node yields the surface. point_in_triangle3d is the real CE math body; structure_bsp_find_material_for_surface is stubbed (surface 0 in lightmap 0 / material 0).

bounds (byte_rectangle3d, +0..6): retail bloodgulch host, leaf walk verbatim (structure_visibility_build_surfaces_traverse_leaf); bounds moved to the parent minimum corner (disjoint probe) -> found=0; other leaf unchanged. Parent = world bounds in the probe (not the node chain). pad (+6): result unchanged, byte retained.

surface_reference_count (+10) and first_surface_reference_index (+12): retail leaf walk verbatim; count 0 -> no surfaces; first index 0 -> the reference span from 0 is walked (expected list from raw refs).

byte_rectangle3d element 0 of structure_bsp.nodes: verbatim structure_visibility_build_surfaces_traverse_node from the root (retail). Baseline descent reaches the probe (found>0); root box zeroed/disjoint -> found=0.

debug reader only: verbatim render_debug_leaf_portal (leaf_map.c:528) over a synthetic nonempty portal; plane_index and leaf_indices mutated -> identical emitted LINE/triangle output (retained, no reader in the draw). leaf_indices is read by leaf_map_close_portal, which the PVS lane's LeafMapParity covers.

test_map_leaf_face_unclassified_0x0_node_index_selects_face_plane: verbatim leaf_map_leaf_spans_polygon (leaf_map.c:566) over a synthetic leaf with one face; node_index (+0) selects the face plane (node 0 -> z=0 crosses x=0 inside the polygon -> SPANS 1; node 1 -> z=5 outside -> SPANS 0). Oracle: edge crossing at (0,+-2,zf) inside [-3,3]^2 iff |zf|<=3. FINDING: no runtime caller in the tree (only the definition and leaf_map.h); the fixture drives the function directly as the ledger requires. Harness build needs -fno-strict-aliasing (CE type-punned real_point3d/real_vector3d access; with strict aliasing the verbatim routine returned 0 for a crossing it should find).

test_real_point2d_unclassified_0x0_vertex_coordinates_drive_crossings: the (x,y) bytes of map_leaf_face.vertices decide the sign changes against the test plane; all-positive face (no sign change) -> SPANS 0; moving one corner across the plane restores a crossing -> SPANS 1. Same no-runtime-caller finding and the same -fno-strict-aliasing build note apply.

test_leaf_portal_vertices_drive_debug_draw and test_leaf_portal_vertices_moved_vertex_changes_only_its_lines (leaf_portal_vertices): verbatim render_debug_leaf_portal (leaf_map.c:528) emits the fan lines and closing lines exactly as the oracle draws the vertex block (debug_draw_oracle), for 3-, 4- and 5-vertex portals; moving vertex 3 changes only the lines naming it. Debug-only consumer; no runtime caller of render_debug_leaf_portal beyond the debug toggles.

test_map_leaf_face_vertices_drive_span_decision and test_map_leaf_face_vertices_moved_corner_changes_decision (map_leaf_face_vertices): verbatim leaf_map_leaf_spans_polygon (leaf_map.c:566) decision matches spans_oracle for five face vertex sets (crossings inside, outside, and no sign change); a moved corner flips it as the oracle predicts. FINDING: leaf_map_leaf_spans_polygon has no runtime caller in the tree.
